name: blender donut tutorial navigation add mesh shade smooth
goal: Start the Blender Guru beginner path: install/open Blender, navigate, delete cube, add torus/cylinder, shade smooth, learn G/R/S.
prerequisites: Ability to install apps or run portable Blender zip
constraints: Prefer real MMB; else viewport gizmo or Edit→Preferences→Input→Emulate 3 Button Mouse (Alt+LMB)
Increase Preferences→Interface Resolution Scale on HiDPI (e.g. 1.5–1.8)
G grab, R rotate, S scale; Tab Object/Edit mode

steps.action: Download Blender 5.x (or current) from blender.org; install or use portable zip; open and click off splash.
Orbit MMB-drag; Shift+MMB pan; scroll zoom; use axis gizmo clicks if upside-down.
Optional: Preferences → Interface Resolution Scale for readable UI; Input Emulate 3 Button Mouse if no MMB.
Shift+A → Mesh add (torus for donut path / cylinder for mug path); adjust Add last-operation settings before clicking away.
Right-click object → Shade Smooth when appropriate.
Practice G/R/S; Tab Edit mode to edit geometry; return to Object mode to select other objects.

verification: Default cube removed and a new mesh added
